name: Chợ Đầm
kicker: The market gate at Bến Chợ
summary: Central market at Bến Chợ: shop the seafood and the bowls in the free lotus hall on a stop in the centre. The hall is 66.5 m across and 5,270 m², built up in 1908 on a former lagoon of 7 ha. Inside are stingray, grouper, squid, shrimp, and crab, plus bún cá, bún chả cá, and nem.
getThere: Bến Chợ, Vạn Thạnh, in the centre.
heroCaption: The Chợ Đầm gate, flags, and the street in front
body: Chợ Đầm is free to enter, at Bến Chợ in Vạn Thạnh. The hall is likened to a lotus: 66.5 m across, 5,270 m², and sized for more than 3,000 people. The site was a 7 ha lagoon. The market was built up in 1908. It is busy every day.
The seafood counter has cá đuối, cá song, mực ống, mực nang, tôm, cua, and ghẹ, fresh, plus dried seafood. The food side has bún cá, bún chả cá, and nem.
